subject: FYI, the mc-stan.org's interface pages were down for a while. I fixed it.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: FYI, the mc-stan.org's interface pages were down for a while. I fixed it.
parts:
I changed the _config.yml's permalink line from:
/:categories/:title/
to
/:categories/:title.html

and now it seems to work. I'm not sure what we can do to prevent pages from going down, but if anyone has ideas, let me know.


Daniel

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] FYI, the mc-stan.org's interface pages were down for a while. I fixed it.
parts:
I couldn’t find an obvious source looking at the commit history, but I’m pretty
sure all of the interface links were working during MCMCSki a few weeks ago.

Just make sure that there aren’t any side effects, such as what should be
folders turning into index pages and the like.

Also, if we merge some of the So Simple Theme updates into our master
than we can use MathJax on the site, if we are so inclined.

Daniel
